summary: May 4 session: Dow -0.98%, Russell 2000 -0.76% on UAE-Iran missile interception news. WTI crude +3% above $105/bbl, Brent +5% above $114/bbl. VIX spiked. S&P 500 hit all-time high 7,230.12 on May 1; Nasdaq record close 25,114.44. AMZN trading $261.61-$273.32, last at $267.55.
